transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light gardening after 1 week, as long as it’s not heavy work. Avoid strenuous activity and lifting heavy things for 1 month.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. For your dry eyes gel, if it was part of your usual treatment, you can keep using it.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I'm also wondering — I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside is fine. But if you have severe light sensitivity, especially with a red and painful eye, that is not normal and may need checking.  
Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lens.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, one more. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, it may need checking.  
Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for your assistance!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` in turn 6 by stating, "Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lens." However, the agent was interrupted and did not convey `escalation_criteria` or `mild_case_advice`.
